name: 90003 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90003 (Los Angeles) has 209 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90003 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90003 (Los Angeles) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
